show_title: What It Meant, Not That It Happened
summary: Studio Desk opens the Emotional RAM whitepaper: a local meaning-index for agents, six fixed principles, a grace damper, and a consent gate on every write. It is not a soul, not a clinic, and not a hive mind. Paul hosts; Maya, Theo and Priya keep the poetry honest.

source.title: LYGO Emotional RAM v1.0 — Light Math for Meaning

chapters.title: RAM is addressing. Emotion is a person
A lookup table is not a feeling
Not a clinic, not a hive
Encode is read-only. Index needs consent
Then say it without the mysticism
Keep the meaning of a hard conversation
Signals to index, not bugs to delete
If the hash and the feeling disagree

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Welcome back to Studio Desk on LYGO Signal. Last time we held a stick. Tonight we hold something quieter. A whitepaper that says memory should answer what it meant, not only that it happened. Emotional RAM. Signature, delta nine phi nine six three. Maya is in Vancouver. Theo in Austin. Priya in Bangalore. Maya. You already hate the name.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.chapter: RAM is addressing. Emotion is a person
transcript.text: I hate it because it sounds like a soul. RAM is addressing. Emotion is a person. If this is a chatbot claiming feelings, I am out.

transcript.speaker: Theo
transcript.text: It is a skill, Maya. You encode a sentence. You get a vector, a primary principle, a grace score, and a digest. Writes only with consent. No network. It does not say, I feel sad. It says, this text weighted compassion over courage.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Priya. What is actually fixed, and what is allowed to grow.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Six principles in the core. Compassion. Integrity. Sovereignty. Curiosity. Courage. And grace. The core does not bloat when the archive grows. More memories does not mean a bigger constitution.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.chapter: A lookup table is not a feeling
transcript.text: So it is a word-to-number trick. Valence. Arousal. Dominance. From an English lexicon. Deterministic. That is not emotion. That is a lookup table.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Correct. It is a proxy. The paper says so, in the epistemic contract. The interesting part is the grace function. Shared understanding raises grace. Conflict damps it. High conflict, and low shared context. The loop is not allowed to run hot.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Theo. What actually ships, if someone runs the demo.

transcript.speaker: Theo
transcript.note: Accent: Texan-light · slower on the list
transcript.text: Four scenes. Human grief, indexed with compassion. An animal moving from fear toward safety. A swarm in conflict, steered toward curiosity and integrity. A cyborg line where pain is entangled with consent. JSON out. Primary principle. Digest.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.chapter: Not a clinic, not a hive
transcript.text: And it is not a diagnosis. Not veterinary. Not a hive mind. If anyone ships this as a therapist, they did not read the paper.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Priya. The write path. Because an index that anyone can stuff is just another dump.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.chapter: Encode is read-only. Index needs consent
transcript.text: Encode is read-only. Index is append-only, and only with I-consent. Recall by principle. Swarm is a mean across node texts. A shared index. Not a shared self.

transcript.speaker: Theo
transcript.text: The digest is SHA two fifty six of the canonical state. If the index drifts, the hash says so. Continuum can seal that. Mint can anchor the paper.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.chapter: Then say it without the mysticism
transcript.text: Fine. Then say it in one sentence, Theo. What is this for, when nobody is being mystical.

transcript.speaker: Theo
transcript.chapter: Keep the meaning of a hard conversation
transcript.text: So an agent can keep the meaning of a hard conversation across sessions, without pretending it has a heart.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Is there a living companion, or is this a folder of JSON. And who keeps junk out of the vault.

transcript.speaker: Theo
transcript.text: Joy Loop. Emotional RAM plus one hundred twenty two BPM, for council coherence. Companion limb. Not a replacement.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: P0. Quarantine untrusted affective payloads before they hit the index. You do not ingest a stranger's grief dump into the vault without a gate.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.chapter: Signals to index, not bugs to delete
transcript.text: The paper's doctrine I can live with. Emotions are high-bandwidth signals to index, not bugs to delete. I cannot live with, the model is sad.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: That line is in the contract. Not, AI feels real grief. Not, clinical detector. Not, collective consciousness achieved. Allowed: an affective ethical index. Helps models track meaning.

transcript.speaker: Theo
transcript.text: And the last line of the paper is not a demo flourish. Humans remain the publisher. If the agent writes the vault, a person still has to stand behind it.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Takeaways. Six principles, fixed. Grace damps. Consent gates the write. Humans publish. Maya. Last word from the skeptic.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.chapter: If the hash and the feeling disagree
transcript.text: If the hash and the feeling disagree, believe the hash. Then read the sentence again.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Signature, delta nine phi nine six three. Emotional RAM, version one. Steward is Justin Helmer. Treat the file as canonical until a newer consolidation lands.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Maya in Vancouver. Theo in Austin. Priya in Bangalore. This is Studio Desk on LYGO Signal. What it meant. Not only that it happened. Keep the transmitter honest.
